But we can’t do it alone. Join us! Partner with DonorsChoose Find a request to support Join the team Student Focus Our commitment to students We are committed to combating disparities in school funding. Our team works to inspire as much support as possible for students who don't have access to the resources that will set them up for success. See projects from underfunded schools Learn more about our student focus Created by teachers, for teachers. In 2000, Charles Best, a teacher at a Bronx public high school, thought about all the money he and his colleagues were spending on books, art supplies, and other materials for their students. They weren't alone — today, teachers still spend an average of over $600 out of pocket on their classrooms each year. Charles figured there were people who'd want to help if they could see where their money was going. He founded DonorsChoose, a website where teachers could post requests for classroom resources, and his colleagues posted the first 11 projects. From vetting every project request to sending resources instead of cash, financial transparency and accountability are core to our model. $155.67 Million Total Operating Expenses 92% Program services 2% General and administrative 6% Fundraising In the 2022–23 school year, more than $140 million directly supported America's public schools. On DonorsChoose, you choose the classroom project you want to support. You support the projects that inspire you, and our team purchases and ships the educator-requested resources directly to the classroom, propelling us towards our mission of giving every student in every community a great education. The efficiency of your donation is a top priority for our team. Program services: 92% The overwhelming majority of our expenses go toward classroom materials like books, art supplies, science equipment, and other resources for students. Program services also include postage for student thank-you letters, coordinating the delivery of materials, building deeper connections with school districts, and improving the DonorsChoose teacher experience. AG-01.name: About-page concreteness
AG-01.finding_requires: a packet page reference (E...), the exact passage read, and which of who / offering / category it leaves unanswered

AG-02.name: Independent mentions
AG-02.finding_requires: the queries executed, each with its result count (zero allowed), and the identity the searches used; scoped to those searches

AG-03.name: Independent contradiction
AG-03.finding_requires: the exact site claim with its packet reference, an inspected conflicting page with URL and quote, why it is the same entity, date or context, and whether the conflict is material

AG-04.name: Facts drawn inside images
AG-04.finding_requires: an image candidate reference (I...) that was actually viewed, the fact transcribed from it, and why the page text does not state it

AG-05.name: Namesake ambiguity
AG-05.finding_requires: the competing entities observed, each with a URL and the fact that distinguishes it from the brand

AG-06.name: Review and profile opportunity
AG-06.finding_requires: the platform queries executed, why the platforms fit the business, and which platforms showed no matching profile
